plugin.note: Flight Kilisa is a melee bodyguard inside Kree'arra's encounter. Use the reviewed Armadyl setup and kill-order plan; generic aviansie routes do not describe this boss room.

requirements: The Armadyl encampment requires 70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple, and the applicable killcount or a valid entry bypass.
Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad are one approach; Ghommal's hilt provides an alternative Trollheim route.
An aviansie task is optional; Kree'arra and all three bodyguards count towards it.
mechanics: Kree'arra and the bodyguards form one encounter. Ranged protection is central while Kree'arra is alive because his ranged hit reaches 69.
Kree'arra's magic attack rolls against ranged defence. His ranged and magic attacks damage all players, so teams have no single designated tank.
Flight Kilisa uses melee up to 15, Wingman Skree magic up to 16, and Flockleader Geerin ranged up to 25.

methods.label: Solo defensive ranged encounter
methods.summary: A defensive crossbow setup handles the complete Armadyl encounter and its melee bodyguard.
prayers: Protect from Missiles while Kree'arra is alive
steps: Keep Kree'arra targeted between attacks and retain ranged protection while he is alive. Untargeted Kree'arra can approach for melee.
Use a corner to prevent knockback, and step under the boss between attacks where the chosen weapon cadence permits.
After Kree'arra dies, kill Wingman Skree with the main ranged weapon or an optional blowpipe, then finish or heal from Kilisa and Geerin.
notes: The Wiki calls this equipment grid Ranged Tank; it describes defensive equipment, not a designated tank role in a group.

methods.label: Solo chinchompa overlap encounter
methods.summary: Chinchompas target the low-defence bodyguard and deal area damage to overlapping Kree'arra.
prayers: Protect from Missiles while Kree'arra is alive
steps: Start in the southwest corner and align Kilisa with Kree'arra's southwest anchor tile.
Throw red or black chinchompas at Kilisa while maintaining Kree'arra as the off-tick target between throws to prevent his melee approach.
Kilisa commonly dies first. Switch to the carried rune crossbow and diamond bolts until the targets overlap again.
When Kree'arra respawns, Geerin can become the alternate overlap target; this is less forgiving and may reduce subsequent blood-spell healing.
risks: Chinchompas are costly and targeting errors can let Kree'arra leave the area or use melee.
The bodyguard is the accuracy target; directly throwing at Kree'arra loses the low-defence targeting advantage.

methods.label: Duo or trio soulflame horn and halberd
methods.summary: The soulflame horn enables guaranteed halberd hits only with a nearby teammate, making this an explicit group method.
prayers: Protect from Missiles while Kree'arra is alive; Protect from Magic when handling Skree afterwards
steps: Use Noxious halberd as the main weapon; ordinary melee weapons cannot reach airborne Kree'arra.
Stand underneath after each attack and use the soulflame horn special with another player nearby.
Coordinate remaining special energy; each member carrying a horn is more reliable than trading one between kills.
After Kree'arra dies, use magic protection while handling Skree, then finish the remaining minions.
notes: The Wiki identifies Noxious halberd as the viable halberd for this method; its extended reach and the horn effect are both essential.
risks: The horn special requires another player nearby. This method is unavailable as a solo encounter.

methods.label: Flight Kilisa: melee pressure and overlap target
methods.summary: Kilisa is the main bodyguard threat to ranged and magic setups.
steps: Her melee attack reaches 15 and is not blocked by ranged protection. Keep that protection for Kree'arra rather than treating Kilisa as an isolated monster.
In solo chinchompa kills, align her with Kree'arra so the low-defence target supplies area damage to the boss.
In teams she changes targets, so spreading out can reduce time she spends attacking. Freezing is an optional Ancient Magicks technique with its own casting requirements.
After the boss dies, stacking Kilisa with Geerin allows blood-spell healing; killing her too early removes that healing target.

methods.label: Armadyl entry and assignment cost
methods.summary: Plan both the dungeon approach and the Armadyl entry check.
steps: Use Death Plateau and Troll Stronghold progress through Dad, or the Ghommal's hilt route to Trollheim.
Carry a crossbow and mith grapple for the 70 Ranged entry. A grapple can be stored in Dizana's quiver where available.
The room normally needs 40 Armadyl killcount, reduced by Combat Achievement tiers, or an ecumenical key or other valid bypass. A key is optional when the killcount requirement is already satisfied.
Collecting Armadyl killcount consumes aviansie task kills, so a bypass preserves more of the assignment for boss-room kills. Appropriate god items prevent aggression on the approach.

methods.label: Encounter targeting and protection
methods.summary: Kree'arra governs the safe setup while any bodyguard is alive.
steps: Kree'arra ranged attacks hit up to 69 and magic up to 21; the magic accuracy roll checks ranged defence.
Both attacks affect all players and can knock them back unless positioned in a corner. A group therefore has no designated tank.
When not targeted, Kree'arra approaches for a melee attack up to 26. Off-tick retargeting is essential for the chinchompa method.
Team players normally bring their strongest ranged weapon; additional player damage makes chinchompas unnecessary.

methods.label: Ancient Magicks sustain and freezing
methods.summary: Blood and ice spells are optional extensions with explicit spell preparation.
steps: After the boss dies, Blood Barrage can heal from stacked Kilisa and Geerin. Blood Blitz is the single-target alternative when Kilisa is dead or nearly dead.

Blood Barrage needs 92 Magic and 4 blood, 4 death and 1 soul rune per cast. Blood Blitz needs 80 Magic and 4 blood plus 2 death runes per cast. Both require Desert Treasure I and Ancient Magicks selected.
Ice Barrage requires 94 Magic with 6 water, 4 death and 2 blood runes per cast and can freeze Kilisa while stacking her with Geerin.

Carry an Ancient-autocasting staff such as a blood ancient sceptre, Kodai wand or eldritch Nightmare staff, plus suitable magic gear. Eldritch specials can restore Prayer; Lightbearer shortens the special-energy recovery wait.
The horn setup can instead use Arceuus Death Charge for special energy; that is a different spellbook preparation and cannot be assumed alongside Ancient Magicks.
risks: A ranged or melee preset does not silently include the level, runes or spellbook for these optional extensions.

methods.label: Supplies, drops and trip length
methods.summary: Use food drops and bones to extend a prepared trip.
steps: The boss and three bodyguards each drop bones. Four Bones to Peaches conversions yield 32 healing; a tablet is the portable option without relying on the spell unlock.
Bodyguards may drop two manta rays for 44 healing or three mushroom potatoes for 60; floor juggling can preserve them when inventory is full.
Shadow trips commonly use three to five brews and five to seven restores; ranged tank trips use twelve to sixteen brews and six to eight restores. Adjust the plan for optional Ancient healing.
Bow and chinchompa trips reserve space for a direct weapon, crossbow/grapple, optional Ancient gear, ammunition, boosts and teleport. Re-check loaded darts, scales, staff charges and crystal charges.
Soulflame teams may switch to Lightbearer after a kill and use restoration or healing supplies while special energy returns.
